title: Octopus eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='61' cy='48' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#fff6fb'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='3' fill='#3c1a4d'/>

  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='1.3' fill='#5b3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='65' r='1.3' fill='#5b3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='65' r='1.2' fill='#5b3a1e'/>

  <path d='M60 72 C62 68 62 66 60 64' stroke='#e8618f' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='44' cy='28' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#ffc0d6' opacity='0.7'/>
